subject: microbiology
title: Schick Test, Bacillus anthracis and Anthrax Diagnosis

steps.tx: The **Schick test** (1913) read diphtheria immunity in skin: intradermal toxin in one forearm, heat inactivated control in the other; redness at toxin site without control reaction meant susceptible (no antitoxin), no reaction immune, both reacting pseudoreaction (protein sensitivity), both fading combined. Obsolete beside antitoxin antibody assays, it remains hypersensitivity classification heritage.
steps.say: Toxin arm red, control arm quiet meant susceptible; Schick read immunity on forearms.

right.title: Schick succession
points: Toxoid boosters by schedule, not skin
Historical role in school immunisation programmes

steps.tx: **Bacillus anthracis** is a large gram positive spore forming boxcar rod (previous morphology), capsulated by poly D glutamic acid (anti phagocytic, McFadyean staining next lesson), non motile and non haemolytic unlike cereus cousins, soil spore persistent, causing cutaneous eschars, inhalational and gastrointestinal anthrax and injectional disease in people who inject drugs.
steps.say: Boxcar rods, glutamate capsule, no motility, no haemolysis: anthracis breaks Bacillus habits.

vis.alt: Anthrax clinical and imaging features including cutaneous eschar
vis.caption: Anthrax key clinical features, the painless eschar with oedema of cutaneous disease.

steps.tx: **Anthrax toxins** are three proteins making two toxins on plasmid pXO1: protective antigen (delivery pore), lethal factor (MAP kinase protease) and oedema factor (adenylyl cyclase), while capsule rides pXO2. PA plus LF is lethal toxin, PA plus EF oedema toxin, antitoxins (raxibacumab, obiltoxaximab) target PA delivery.
steps.say: One delivery truck, two poisons: block protective antigen and both toxins stall.

left.title: Toxin components
points: Protective antigen: receptor binding and pore

right.title: Capsule plasmid
points: pXO2 encodes poly D glutamic acid capsule
Loss of either plasmid attenuates (Sterne vaccine lacks pXO2)
Toxin and capsule together define virulence

steps.tx: **Cutaneous anthrax** (95 percent natural cases) evolves papule to vesicle to painless black eschar with striking oedema over one to two weeks after spore inoculation through skin breaks (hide, wool, animal work), usually curable with ciprofloxacin or doxycycline, eschar itself needing no surgery or debridement heroics.
steps.say: Painless eschar, dramatic oedema, animal contact: leave the eschar, give the antibiotic.

right.title: Eschar differentials
points: Orf and cowpox in animal workers
Culture and PCR from vesicle fluid and eschar edge

steps.tx: **Inhalational anthrax** incubates days to weeks (spores dormantly macrophage carried), prodrome flu like, then fulminant mediastinitis with widened mediastinum, haemorrhagic effusions, shock and meningitis in half, treated with combination bactericidal plus protein synthesis inhibitor plus antitoxin in modern guidance, post exposure prophylaxis 60 days because spores germinate late.
steps.say: Widened mediastinum after a flu prodrome in an exposed worker is anthrax until excluded.

left.title: Inhalational portrait
points: Gram positive rods in blood cultures late

right.title: Response logic
points: Combination therapy plus antitoxin for systemic
PEP ciprofloxacin or doxycycline 60 days plus vaccine series
Public health and law enforcement joint investigation deliberate

steps.tx: **Anthrax diagnosis and biosafety**: swab vesicle fluid and blood cultures (rods may appear), PCR at reference laboratories, Ascoli precipitin test heritage for animal products, specimens handled BSL2 with BSL3 culture precautions, and immediate notification because natural versus deliberate is first a laboratory and veterinary question.
steps.say: Notify on suspicion and let reference laboratories confirm; anthrax is never a bench surprise to keep.

left.title: Diagnostic stack
points: Gram stain boxcar rods in fluid or blood
Culture non haemolytic medusa colonies (next lesson)

steps.tx: **Gastrointestinal and injectional anthrax** complete forms: oropharyngeal and bowel disease from undercooked infected meat (necrotic ulcers, ascites, sepsis), injectional from contaminated heroin (severe soft tissue without classic eschar), each treated systemically and investigated as source events. Veterinary and wildlife reservoirs also maintain spores independently of human cases, so eradication is not a realistic objective.
steps.say: Meat and needles deliver the other anthrax forms; tissue destruction outruns skin signs.

right.title: Injectional anthrax
points: Severe soft tissue infection, compartment syndromes

steps.tx: **Anthrax vaccination** (AVA adsorbed PA, newer adjuvanted) serves military, laboratory and post exposure roles (with 60 day antibiotics), animal live spore Sterne vaccine controls livestock reservoirs, carcass disposal (no opening, deep burial or burning) preventing soil seeding. One health before the phrase existed.
steps.say: Vaccinate herds, bury carcasses whole, PEP for sixty days: spores set every timeline.

right.title: Animal and soil
points: Incineration or deep burial with lime traditions
